about: Reviewed verdicts for the promises in public/promises.json (scripts/build-promises.mjs), by person and promise key ("<first question>@<date>"). status: kept, step (voted for a first step toward it: counts 3/4), compromise (introduced or (co)sponsored a compromised version: counts 1/2), broken, unclear, no-action, not-tested, not-a-promise (left out), promise (a statement the wording test missed). why is shown on the profile; date is when it was reviewed.

paris-agreement@2020-11-03.why: The President rejoined the Paris Agreement on Jan. 20, 2021, the day Ossoff took office, so there was nothing left to push for; the U.S. left again by executive order in 2025, and neither step came to a Senate vote.

tariffs@2024-11-05.why: She promised tariffs that protect Ohio factories. The votes against were to end the 2025 national emergency behind the tariffs on Canadian goods, a broad tariff rather than a targeted one, so whether they go against the promise depends on how it is read.

national-sales-tax@2024-11-05.why: About her opponent's positions, not a promise of hers.
